summary: All 12 acceptance criteria are satisfied. The 8 new config keys (6 EVAL_HEALTH_* + 2 PHASE3_*) are present with correct defaults. The evaluator_health_penalty function correctly computes skip-ratio, exec-ratio, and max-positions penalties with proper role multipliers (1.5x skip/exec, 1.2x positions for 'test'). execution_ok correctly returns False for zero/missing raw_signal_count. Both functions are wired into Phase 3 _robust_combo_return (per-rule-set score subtracts train+val penalty × weight) and Phase 4 Optuna trial (val-only penalty × weight). gate_positive_good has the new require_execution_health kwarg (default False for backward compat), and all 4 internal call sites pass the PHASE3_GATE_EXECUTION_HEALTH config flag (default True). The new test file has 24 test cases (≥ 8 required). All 23 Task 3 backward-compat tests still pass. No changes to evaluator_v5.ipynb, GPU engine, or JSON output format. The CPU engine already exposed all 7 required fields — no modifications needed there. Implementation faithfully ports the friend's _evaluator_health_penalty and execution_ok from rb_governor.py with the EVAL_HEALTH_ config prefix as specified.
